VORON DownDraft

An animated 3D companion to the official DownDraft assembly manual. Spread the toolhead along its assembly paths, drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, and click a part to see its name and the step that installs it.

Unofficial. This is an independent community project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by the VORON Design team. The official assembly manual is the reference: where the two differ, follow the official manual.

Credits

The VORON DownDraft toolhead is designed by the VORON Design team and its community contributors.

The 3D model, the step order and the instructions here come from their open-source voron-downdraft release: the CAD assembly and the assembly manual (version 2026-08-15), used under GPL-3.0. VORON and the VORON logo belong to VORON Design.
